id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Who would have thought a place like this would be hidden at the top of that mountain trail? It's breathtaking...
"Oh, stop it, you're making me blush! Although, I suppose the old hometown is pretty amazing...
"Indeed! Welcome to Arboria, home of the Keepers who watch over the world from beneath Yggdrasil. And of Veronica and I!
"I always thought it was a little bit, well...dull... but it's good to be back!
"The altar in the vision seemed to be in the highest part of the First Forest, just beyond the village.
"But we should stop off in Arboria first. Everyone will be ever so pleased the Luminary has come to visit!
